Light grey micro-cement backsplash matching the wall finish seamlessly, polished light grey concrete-look large-format floor tiles. Recessed ceiling lights and a single minimal track-mounted adjustable spot above the sink.

images.caption: Copper Accent Warm Luxe Kitchen
images.alt: Warm luxury modular kitchen with copper accent fixtures and rich material palette
images.scenePrompt: Sumptuously warm modular kitchen with rich chocolate brown PU-painted cabinets and distinctive copper accent hardware throughout — copper knobs, copper sink, copper range hood, and copper-finish light fixtures. Dark Brown Emperador marble countertop with honey-coloured veining echoing the copper theme. Backsplash in small square copper mosaic tiles with verdigris patina variation. Dark stained wide-plank acacia wood flooring, warm dimmed recessed lights, and two hammered copper dome pendant lights casting warm amber pools on the workspace below.
